title: centaurium umbellatum subsp. suffruticosum
intro: Centaurium umbellatum subsp. suffruticosum, commonly known as Mountain Bladderwort or Small-flowered Bladderwort, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the gentian family, characterized by its small, white or pinkish flowers and its ability to thrive in shaded, moist environments. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antiseptic and diuretic, helping to treat conditions such as urinary tract infections and kidney stones. The therapeutic actions of Centaurium umbellatum subsp. suffruticosum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, among others. These constituents work together to exert a range of beneficial effects on the body, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial actions.
